import html # Template for the user profile display. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{bio}

{status_msg}
""" def show_user_profile(name: str, bio: str, status_msg: str) -> str: """ Sanitize user-provided data and return an HTML snippet that displays a user profile. Parameters: name (str): The user's name. bio (str): The user's biography, may contain multiple sentences. status_msg (str): A short status message or one-liner from the user. Returns: str: A safe, concatenated HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent XSS and other injection attacks safe_name = html.escape(name, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status_msg = html.escape(status_msg, quote=True) # Format the profile using the template rendered_profile = PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status_msg=safe_status_msg ) return rendered_profile.strip()
